carta-compensation-app.name: Total Compensation app
prompts: Launch the compensation console for {{COMPANY}}
Open the pay benchmarks for {{COMPANY}} so I can filter them by job area

carta-compensation-benchmarks.name: Market pay benchmarks
prompts: What are the market benchmarks for a [job title]?
Put the P25/P50/P75 salary and equity ranges for our sales roles in a CSV

whatsNewCopy.headline: Get market salary and equity ranges for any role
whatsNewCopy.body: Pulls Carta Total Compensation benchmarks for the role into a chat table or CSV, with salary, equity and total cash at each percentile.

carta-compensation-rolematcher.name: Role classification
prompts: How would the title '[job title]' map to the compensation taxonomy?
What job area, focus, level, and track does this job description fall into?

whatsNewCopy.headline: Map any job title to Carta's compensation levels
whatsNewCopy.body: Classifies one title or a whole list into job area, focus, level and track in chat, so every role is benchmarked against the right peers.

carta-compensation-scorecard.name: Comp scorecard
prompts: How is our pay positioned against market for our employees?
Which employees at {{COMPANY}} are below P50 for their role?

whatsNewCopy.headline: See who's paid below, at or above market
whatsNewCopy.body: Compares each employee's pay to Carta Total Compensation benchmarks in chat, with a company rollup and per-person compa-ratios that match your Total Compensation product.

carta-conversion-calculator.name: SAFE & note conversion
prompts: How would the outstanding SAFEs and notes for {{COMPANY}} convert at $2.50 per share?
If we raise a $10M round at a $60M pre-money valuation, how many shares do our SAFEs convert into?

whatsNewCopy.headline: See how your SAFEs and notes convert next round
whatsNewCopy.body: Reads every SAFE and note on your Carta cap table and works out each one's conversion shares at your round price, caps and discounts included.

carta-grant-vesting.name: Vesting progress
prompts: How much has [employee name]'s option grant vested so far?
When does [employee name]'s cliff hit, and how many shares are still unvested?
Show me the vesting schedule for [employee name]'s RSUs at {{COMPANY}}

whatsNewCopy.headline: See exactly how much of a grant has vested
whatsNewCopy.body: Reads one person's option, RSU or other grant from Carta and shows vested and unvested shares, the cliff date and what vests next, in chat.

carta-issuance.name: Issue equity
prompts: Issue a 10,000-share NSO grant to [employee name] at {{COMPANY}}
Draft the option grants in this spreadsheet for {{COMPANY}}
Resume issuing from my last draft set for {{COMPANY}}

whatsNewCopy.headline: Issue grants and certificates from a spreadsheet or a sentence
whatsNewCopy.body: Turns a spreadsheet, award document or plain request into drafts on your Carta cap table, then issues them only after you review each one.

carta-market-benchmarks.name: Market norms
prompts: What is a typical option pool size at our stage?
How do our SAFE valuation caps and discount rates compare to the market?

whatsNewCopy.headline: Check new deal terms against your own portfolio
whatsNewCopy.body: Computes the median and range of option pool sizes, SAFE valuation caps and round sizes across your companies in Carta, answered in chat.

carta-modify-issuables.name: Fix a grant or certificate
prompts: Update the vesting start date on [employee name]'s option grant
Correct the exercise price on certificate [certificate label] for {{COMPANY}}

whatsNewCopy.headline: Fix dates, prices or quantities on issued equity
whatsNewCopy.body: Opens a form to edit an issued certificate or option grant on your Carta cap table, then shows a before-and-after review before anything saves.

carta-portfolio-alerts.name: Risk & expiration alerts
prompts: What's expiring soon across our 409A valuations, SAFEs, option pool, and 83(b) deadlines?
Which convertible notes mature in the next 90 days?
Is the option pool running low at {{COMPANY}}?

whatsNewCopy.headline: Catch expiring 409As, SAFEs and deadlines before they lapse
whatsNewCopy.body: Scans your companies in Carta for expiring 409As, SAFEs near their cap, low option pools and unfiled 83(b) elections, ranked by severity in chat.

carta-register-of-allotments.name: Register of allotments (UK)
prompts: Show me the register of allotments for {{COMPANY}}
Which allotments at {{COMPANY}} are still missing an SH01 filing?

whatsNewCopy.headline: See your UK statutory register of allotments
whatsNewCopy.body: Lists every share allotment from your Carta cap table with holder, share class, quantity, price and date, and shows which SH01 returns are filed.

carta-reporting.name: Cap table lookup
prompts: Show me every option grant at {{COMPANY}} with its holder, quantity, and status
List every outstanding security for {{COMPANY}} with its share class and quantity
Show me the SAFEs and convertible notes outstanding for {{COMPANY}}

whatsNewCopy.headline: Build any cap table report without exports or SQL
whatsNewCopy.body: Pulls grants, stakeholders, SAFEs or preferences from Carta into a filtered, sorted report you open as an interactive table, markdown or Excel.

carta-reporting-excel.name: Excel cap table export
prompts: Export the cap table report for {{COMPANY}} to Excel
Export the securities ledger for {{COMPANY}} to Excel, sorted by issue date

whatsNewCopy.headline: Export a branded cap table report to Excel
whatsNewCopy.body: Turns the Carta report you set up into a formatted Excel file with your chosen columns, filters and sorts, ready to share.

carta-round-history.name: Financing round history
prompts: Show the financing round history for {{COMPANY}} and who invested in each round
What was the price per share and total raised in our last priced round?

whatsNewCopy.headline: See every financing round and who invested
whatsNewCopy.body: Reads your Carta cap table into a round-by-round table of dates, share classes, price per share, cash raised and the investors in each round.

carta-stakeholder-ledger-companion.name: Stakeholder ledger
prompts: Show me the stakeholders at {{COMPANY}}
Show me [stakeholder name]'s holdings

whatsNewCopy.headline: Browse your stakeholders on a live ledger beside chat
whatsNewCopy.body: Opens Carta's read-only stakeholder ledger next to the chat and follows along as you ask about anyone, from their details to every holding.

carta-valuation-history.name: Valuation & FMV history
prompts: What is the current 409A valuation for {{COMPANY}}?
How has our FMV changed over time, and when does the current 409A expire?

whatsNewCopy.headline: Check your current FMV and every past valuation
whatsNewCopy.body: Reads your 409A, EMI, CSOP or share price valuations from Carta and shows current fair market value, past values and expiry dates in chat.

carta-voting-rights-optimizer.name: Voting coalition finder
prompts: Which stockholders do we need to approve this charter amendment?
Can we reach 66% approval without [investor name]?
Here's our voting rights report — what's the smallest coalition that passes the protective provision?

whatsNewCopy.headline: Find the fewest stockholders needed to pass a vote
whatsNewCopy.body: Reads your Carta voting rights report and charter thresholds, then works out the smallest coalition that approves an amendment, step by step in chat.

carta-witness-signatures.name: Signature status
prompts: Which grants at {{COMPANY}} are still waiting on a witness signature?
Which awards are awaiting spousal consent, and which requests have expired?

whatsNewCopy.headline: See which equity awards still need a signature
whatsNewCopy.body: Checks witness and spousal-consent requests on option grants, RSAs and PIUs in Carta and lists who still needs to sign, for one company or many.
